item.title: By: tveskov
item.dc:creator: tveskov
item.description: Douglas Merril talk was really good, thanks for sharing. Many good soundbites in there but “Giving innovations a very, very long spring” stuck with me. Innovation is a fragile thing so often things need a long time to grow (or die).
